reviews.author: Hye Ok Lee
reviews.text:
It is a small, but clean and healing space.
Until recently, the director insisted on using only genuine Decleo products, and since Decleo withdrew from Seoul, he now uses Delarome, a famous French cosmetics brand. Unlike other spas that are mushrooming these days, the fact that there are many regulars for several years shows that the director's strict management and honesty in dealing with customers are remarkable.
Williams Spa is also famous for being a place where famous foreign stars come and pay for spa treatments, not through PPL but through word of mouth. I feel like all my stress melts away when I get a one-person spa treatment in a small, clean, and comfortable space.
You can appreciate the true value of Williams Spa just by visiting Williams Spa, drinking fragrant tea, and receiving a consultation. This is one of the few honest spas in Seoul!

reviews.author: Kyeong-yeon Lee
reviews.text:
This is a place I went to for two years.
I've been to many good spas, but there are few that I like as much as this one.
You can always trust the care provided by the director himself.
You can relax comfortably in a cozy space.
The director is not very interested in marketing.
It is with a sad heart that I am leaving a review for the first time in my life.
Please come and receive care in person.
I 100% guarantee that you will be satisfied.
The product I receive is Delarome and I think there are other products as well.
The location is on the 3rd floor of the officetel in front of Sinchon Grand Xi.
